# IPinfo Lite test fixture

`ipinfo_lite.sample.mmdb` is the public sample downloaded on 2026-10-30 from
https://ipinfo.io/data/sample/ipinfo_lite.mmdb . It is used only by local tests.

IP address data powered by [IPinfo](https://ipinfo.io).
License: [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
The file is unmodified. Full production data is downloaded by each installation
using its own IPinfo Token, or mounted by its operator.
